subject.title: Add Atomic Chat as a bundled local provider (OpenAI-compatible, 127.0.0.1:1337)

question: Should Atomic Chat be promoted into OpenClaw's bundled provider surface, or should it stay as an external provider/plugin or custom-provider docs recipe?
rationale: The current plugin and custom-provider seams can support Atomic Chat outside core, while bundling it changes provider, auth, onboarding, docs, dependency, and maintenance surface that automation should not decide.

options.title: Keep as external/custom-provider path
options.body: Use the existing custom OpenAI-compatible provider docs and ClawHub/provider-plugin distribution unless maintainers explicitly sponsor bundled promotion.

options.title: Sponsor bundled provider
options.body: Approve Atomic Chat as bundled product surface and require the linked implementation PR to clear dependency, compatibility, labeler, and review blockers before merge.

options.title: Land docs-only mitigation first
options.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90401 as a narrower user guide while postponing the bundled-provider decision.

recommendation.title: Keep as external/custom-provider path
recommendation.body: Use the existing custom OpenAI-compatible provider docs and ClawHub/provider-plugin distribution unless maintainers explicitly sponsor bundled promotion.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision sits on plugin/core boundary and provider-curation policy where git history shows the strongest ownership signal.
